_comment: EXTENDED wire shape (supervisor-silent-listen, boundary gap 1). GET /api/v1/supervisor/sessions/active answers 200 with an array of ActiveSessionDto. Existing fields keep their meaning (sessionId: Agent Assist session id; agentId, queueName, callerIdNum, connectedAt from the SDK call session, each string|null). NEW: conversationId (string|null, always written) is the tracked voice conversation of the session's call in the CALLER's tenant, resolved by the call's linked id exactly as AgentAssistBridge resolves it (AgentAssistBridge.cs:148-154); null when none resolves. Web uses it to start POST /api/v1/supervisor/conversations/{conversationId}/listen. Every child change's delta spec must cite these field names VERBATIM (verbatim-fixture-citation rule, /xr:propagate).
